id.patternErrorMessage: Use a kebab-case id: lowercase letters and digits, joined by single hyphens (disney-plus)

name.description: Whose document it is: The Walt Disney Company’s privacy policy
As the card links it (Terms of use)

links.description: The terms, privacy policy and other pages the ratings quote, as the card links them

topic.patternErrorMessage: Use kebab-case segments joined by dots (video.quality, password-manager.item-types)

title.description: What stands out, in a few words: only on a titled topic (other.notable)

tier.description: The rubric's grade its quotes fit

status.description: Instead of a tier: not-stated when the pages read don't address it, not-applicable when it can't apply (no free trial)

reason.description: Why, in plain words anyone can follow, shown beside the grade

url.description: The page the quote is on: one of the links

quote.description: The provider's own words there, word for word

sources.description: Where it says so: a graded rating quotes one to three

pages.description: With a status: the pages read that don't address it (not-stated) or show it can't apply, each one in links

plans.description: Only these plans (an ad tier's tracking), over a rating for every plan

items.patternErrorMessage: Use a two-letter ISO 3166-1 region in capitals (CA, US) or GLOBAL

regions.description: Only buyers here (a country's own terms), over a rating for everywhere

name.description: What the link does, as the card shows it: How to turn off Behavioral Advertising

url.description: The page, on the provider's own sites or its policies' site, that its policy or help pages link for it

action.description: Where to change what the reason says the user has to change themselves (M5.12)

replacesShared.description: Its own document says it applies instead of the shared one's clause (quoted in sources): it wins over a shared rating of the topic, which otherwise wins when it's worse

lastVerified.patternErrorMessage: Use a real date written YYYY-MM-DD

title: Simply Sub shared policy document
description: data/policies/<id>.yaml: a policy that covers several providers, rated once (BLUEPRINT §4.10)
